items.note: S1.2 states the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch, and S1.2.1-S1.2.4 follow the proof at 744-764 exactly ((JV+RG)x, the two central coefficients, the three stages). But h=100, the triple index set, the neighbour rules (|S cap T|=1 / even intersection) and the wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are never given.

The steps follow 804-825: the invariant that the stored array is D_v applied to the logical array, the common frame commuting with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}.

The bilinear form, terminal labels, stage fitting, side-wire nesting, telescoping, L=Ich, |Delta dim| sum Wm-2N+2L, orthonormal bases and the ratios 100/539, 101/539 are all present. The per-time gate labels (eq:motif-labels, 960-990) and the residual table (1021-1043) are missing, so the claim that only the central 3->4 edges decrease is asserted, not shown.

Projection assignment, the rank of P_V-P_U, the N exceptional 2P_{U_a} edges, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b with deficit N-2L_b>0, and the endpoint identity I_m giving H<-H+D on every role all match 1115-1171; the frame Phi_M appears in S1.4.3.2.2.

The steps follow 1231-1314: weight additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, odd weight giving eps=+-1, Hadamard conjugation to aI+bX_v, the count s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c, and C^{tensor m} on every role after the 27-coordinate Z corrections. The tensoring over k columns is not mentioned.

L/N<1/2, both strict deficits, eta_b and eta_c exceeding 20*2^-50, log m<20 and s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^-50 all match the paper. Like the paper, the plan quotes the exact eta values without recomputing them from the wire counts.

The digit permutations, digit moves, splits and merges, cyclic row dealing, counter accounting, block rotation for controlled shifts, the b^{O(1)} absorption, multiplication by a unit and negation all follow 512-626.
E_1 Pi E_2 by top-row elimination, linear-time lower-triangular updates with a prime q avoiding denominators, and one interchange per one of Pi, giving exactly a interchanges. All match 1375-1446.

The steps cover row dealing, edge shears by recursive interchanges, the frame identity giving Phi_{I_m}, the three-shear interchange, s calls on V/W, the recurrence and its unrolling, the fixed-tape schedule and descriptor work, as in 1491-1615.
The steps follow 1649-1761: high digits as the row field with R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padding to R'<2R, base-m pieces summing to O(Ve^tau), binary padding to [q^e], and the one-bit unequal-width case.

The steps cover the basic identities, the edge product of kernels, conjugation by P_M, slots of f chunks, inverse children via Z wrappers, the row-addition count, s_c child calls and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, matching 1814-1940.

The steps cover the eight additions and their parity cycles, packed cyclic shifts, the guard interval and bad set with delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^-K}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, the swaps and rotations, radix-sort repair, and the final o(1) terms. All follow 2013-2231.
Node overhead O(V((eK)^tau+1)), rows from the first q_0 chunks, V/W role streams, F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves O(e), and the three-part summation to O(d^lambda') all match 2286-2445.
Depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the B^{k+1} bound, Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1})=o(p), uniform packed costs, one final truncation, and error <sqrt2*2^-p with disk output all follow 2457-2758.

The steps cover character cancellation, DIF rounds and bit reversal B_t, the reverse procedure F^+B^{-1}, the layout L (prefix moves and Dq-1 chunk exchanges), layer rounds, monomials, the single truncation per round, the sqrt2*l*2^-p error and the cost. All follow 2819-3199.

The steps cover B_0=2^{4p}, the |h_j|<B_0/2 separation, two's-complement packing, centred extraction with carries, ac-be and ae+bc, negacyclic wrap, ||fg/r||<=||f||||g||, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost, as in 3233-3367.
The normalisation identity, P(LBu,LBv)=LB P(u,v), the error chain 2delta, 2delta+eta, 3delta+eta and M(3delta+eta), and the cost match 3414-3494.

The steps cover N=CTD, the cited Gaussian identity and the ||N-I|| bound, the Neumann inverse, normalisations giving 2^{-2alpha^2}, ordered numerical maps, selection C, tensoring, line costs and axis exposure O(d^2) swaps, as in 3576-3890. The record-format conversions are not covered.
The chirp's periodicity and coefficient identity, the dilation identity RF^+R=F^+, commuting with pointwise products, the 1/S^2 normalisation and conjugation all follow 3938-3987.

The constants, sizes, prime interval, S/T>1/2, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} prime search all match. The verification at 4018-4035 that the fixed exponents satisfy the layer and margin conditions (tau(1+c/beta)<1-31*2^-55<lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)=1-2^-51<lambda', epsilon C_1<1, ...) is not reproduced.

The steps cover the isomorphism, the triangular formula for b_i, the update order d..1, rotations on the valid interval in the padded box, offset setup o(Tp), O(d^2) axis moves and the total cost, as in 4216-4291.
Well-definedness, the diagonal isomorphism, the wrap check, M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g), the computed twist sequence and the three twist errors below 4 h_p all match the paper.
The chirp transform, the source transform with exact counterpart RF_s, F^+ by conjugation, digit scaling by 2^{-b-2}, the six steps and the two roles of S all follow 4417-4544.

The error chain E_ring<5TL, 6TL, 8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, (2E_s+2), (3E_s+2), E_w<28*2^gamma T^2 L and the final 448b 2^{-3b/4}<1/2, plus capacity and carries, match. The wording of S4.7.8 on the scalings is loose (see errors).

The table rows and powers, the margins g_1..g_7 with min 2^-181=2kappa, the per-row justifications, the o(V) setup and exceptional streams, log-power absorption and the schoolbook cutoff all follow 4815-4994.
S0 lists integer-multiplication-conjecture among its dependencies, but no step states the eventual lower bound, its negation by liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0, or that the bound refutes it.

errors.says: The rank-saving scheme gives cost per volume O(e^tau) at parameter e, both for the bit network (address interchange) and for the complex network (butterfly layers).
errors.paper: Only the bit-network recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) gives O(e^tau). The complex-network recurrence has node overhead O((eK)^tau+1) and leaves O(e), and gives O(d^lambda') with max{lambda, sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda'<1. S1.4.4.3 states this correctly.

errors.says: Method: choose labels so that gather and scatter coefficients depend on the intersection size.
errors.paper: The gather and scatter coefficients are fixed by the scalar network. The labels come from a bilinear form with <t_S,t_T>=|S cap T|-1 (or the F_2 dot product), chosen so that neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal and side-wire labels can nest.

errors.says: Every nonzero residual contains a norm-one coordinate unit.
errors.paper: The norm-one vector in a residual is built by tensoring chosen norm-one vectors, including the tensor triple-indicator vectors spanning P and Q. In general it is not a coordinate unit of the whole space.

errors.says: No extra source ranks are needed, so the deficit is larger than in the bit network.
errors.paper: The paper says only that the deficit is 2N-2L_c>0. The absolute deficit is larger, but the relative deficits that drive the exponent go the other way: eta_c=73/19906842167500 < eta_b=339/22587335000000.

errors.says: The error after the two exact scalings by S and 2^{2b+4} is bounded by their product times E_w h_p.
errors.paper: E_w h_p is already the error after the first scale by S. The second scale is by 2^{2b+4}S, and the final error is 2^{2b+4}S times E_w h_p. The plan's S4.7.9 states that bound correctly.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route from start to finish. It builds the two tape procedures from the bank-exchange network, frames, labels and rank count (S1), uses them in the ring convolution (S2), handles prime lengths by resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation (S3), then assembles the algorithm, exact recovery (S4) and the margin-based time bound (S5). It thins out at its base. The network's fixed parameters (h=100, N, m=h^3, W) are never stated, the gate-label table behind 'only the central 3->4 edges decrease' is asserted rather than shown, and the check that the fixed exponents meet the layer conditions is omitted. S1.4's summary also overclaims an O(e^tau) bound for the complex network.

steps.note: The plan has the fixed linear network, the data banks X_a,Y_a, the signed exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and the restoration of scratch wires. But h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear (S1.4.1 has only '3-element subsets of [h]'), so the defining quantities are missing.
S1.3 states that a common invertible frame commutes with the pointwise gate, so the network on arrays is D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} and each edge pays only D_v D_u^{-1}.
S1.4.1 gives nested nondegenerate subspaces of F^{tensor 3}. S1.4.1.5 states that every edge joins comparable labels and that the only decrease is the central 3->4 edge, losing P⊗F⊗Q of dimension h.
S1.4.1.8.2 gives rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U. S1.4.1.8.3 gives the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change.
S1.4.1.7 gives L=Ich and sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L. S1.4.1.8.1 gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
The plan gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit is N-2L_b>0 and s_b<W_b m (and similarly for the complex network).
S1.4.1.8.5 gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and I_m on every other role, hence H<-H+D on every role. S1.4.3.2.3 applies it through Phi_{I_m}.
The plan factors A=E_1 Pi E_2 so that a rank-a shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V). S1.4.3.2.5 concludes that a node makes exactly s recursive calls.
The plan has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^-50 from eta>20*2^-50 and log m<20. It concludes F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely. It has frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N exceptional source ranks, the Wm-2N+2L budget, L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^-50. Only the fixed network's defining parameters (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) are missing, so C1 is only mentioned.
